skills: Hold, spending 1 Assist Point: throws her shield around her for Physical DMG.
Shield charge for Physical DMG, taking 40% less DMG. Blocking a hit lets her Retaliate into Roaring Thrust or Overpowered Shield Bash.
Parries for massive Daze; uses fewer Assist Points under heavy attack.
Spinning shield throw and slash for Physical DMG; can Retaliate after.

Shield strike for Physical DMG. Hit right at the start, it's a Perfect Block that negates the hit and auto-follows with Roaring Thrust. Then she guards (40% less DMG); blocking lets her Retaliate. Invulnerable during Retaliation.

Shield strike and thrust for massive Physical DMG. A Perfect Block (hit at the start, or interrupting with the shield) negates the hit; then Overpowered Shield Bash costs no Energy. Guards after, like her Special.
Shield strike for massive Physical DMG. A Perfect Block refunds its Energy (not when it was itself used from a block or Retaliation).
Perfect Block, Retaliation or Defensive Assist raise her Impact for 3s (scales with skill level).
Downward strike for massive Physical DMG.
Shield throw and downward strike for massive Physical DMG, with extra Daze on shielded enemies.

core.name: Barrier of Resilience
core.text: Parry Counter, Chain, Ultimate, or Overpowered Shield Bash via Retaliation give the squad Radiant Aegis for 90s: a shared Shield of {0}% of her base Impact + {1}, worn by the on-field Agent. The wearer gets higher Anti-Interrupt and +{2} ATK, lasting 5s past the Shield.

ability.name: Battle Spirit
ability.text: Perfect Block, Retaliation, Defensive Assist or Dead End makes enemies within 7m take 25% more DMG from the squad for 30s.

mindscapes: Entering combat or switching in gives Radiant Aegis (once per 300s). While it's up, enemies within 5m of the wearer lose 15% Attribute DMG RES.
While Radiant Aegis is up, her Energy Generation rises by 10% and the wearer's ATK bonus is 150% of normal.
Chain or Ultimate gives 3 Assist Points. Below 20 Energy she can pay 1 Assist Point for Overpowered Shield Bash instead (once per 5s).
Overpowered Shield Bash and Aiding Blade always CRIT, deal +50% DMG and +50% more to the main target, and give her +30% CRIT Rate and +60% CRIT DMG for 15s.
